mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide may increase valproic acid levels through reduced renal clearance and altered protein binding, while valproic acid can cause hyperammonemia which may be exacerbated by thiazide-induced electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor serum valproic acid concentrations, ammonia levels, and electrolytes (particularly sodium and potassium); adjust valproic acid dosing if necessary and ensure adequate hydration.
